notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.8
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515520?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=patch008&utm_medium=web]Fall Of The Son[/url] Patch 0.0.8 is now live.

This patch features a huge range of updates, including new functionality such as gold rewards and shops to spend your gold on cards or powerful artifacts. The bonfire system has also been reworked to use a new resource called Kindling, this allows you to potentially use multiple options at a bonfire or a mixture as Kindling can now drop as a combat reward.

The game route has also been adjusted, with a guaranteed bonfire now occuring before the final boss. There are also minor balance changes, as well as a number of bug fixes.

notes.title: Fall Of The Son Patch 0.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Fall Of The Son[/h1]
[h2]Patch 0.0.1[/h2]

Welcome to our first patch of the early access period. In this patch we look to address some of the feedback from players. We have also now made the draw pile show in a randomised order, as technically this is closed information. To compensate, the player starting health is buffed in non-survival runs and the [b]Eternal Heart[/b] artifact is buffed in survival mode. Read the full details of the patch below:

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cards in the draw pile are now shown in a randomised order
[*]Player starting health 50 -> 55
[*][i]Surival mode:[/i] [b]Eternal Heart[/b] now grants 1 hp per enemy defeated in each battle (previously 1 hp per battle)
[/list]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]1 new random event added
[/list]

[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*]Events that grant cards now have popups to show what the card is when the card name is hovered over in the option
[/list]

notes.title: Fall Of The Son Release
notes.content:
[h2]Fall Of The Son[/h2]        
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515520/Fall_Of_The_Son/]Store page[/url]

        
[b]Fall Of The Son[/b] is a roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble powerful strategies to battle through hordes of enemies - with 3 playable characters and over 200 unique cards at your disposal. Do you have the grit and determination to make it to the end and face off against [u]The Son[/u]?

[h3]Classes[/h3]
[list][*]Warrior[/*][*]Rogue[/*][*]Wizard[/*][/list] 

[h3]Roguelike[/h3] 
Features a random map and enemy selection during each run. This will consist of battles, rest points and random events. Your progress is lost upon death.

[h3]Deckbuilder[/h3]
Select a new card to add to your deck at the end of each combat. Gain access to additional cards and strategies during random events.

[h3]Additional modifiers[/h3]
[list][*]Survival - for a truly hardcore experience[/*][*]Random/upgraded deck - for a more casual/chaotic experience[/*][/list]
     
[h3]Wiki[/h3]   
You can view the full card pool on the [url=https://nomoregamesstudio.jmlventures.co.uk/wiki]wiki[/url] page.
